summary: The change adds a two-line guard to the AuditLog.verify() method in payments, rejecting any audit trail whose first sequence number is below 1. This strengthens the tamper-evident audit chain (AUD-2) without altering the recording path (AUD-1). The prior modelcheck evidence for AUD-2 lapses under LAP-1 because verify was modified, but the registered exhaustive control test for AUD-2 passed in CI on the final commit, providing new evidence of equivalent strength. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-5, CHG-6, CHG-7, EXC-1) are satisfied: the ticket is approved and covers the correct component, an independent code review and a security review (required because the component is security-sensitive) were both recorded on the head commit, and no protected paths or emergency procedures are involved. The decision is ACCEPT.
